indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Gained about 327 points, ending a seven-day losing streak and leaving correction territory.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Jumped about 1,472 points and is back to a gain of about 3.6% for 2026.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Rose about 1,448 points as the rally spread well beyond tech.

notes: Nvidia soared about 31% after its board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, effective immediately; it was the main driver of the biggest one-day gains for the indexes since April 2025.

Beaten-down AI and chip names bounced hard: Micron rose about 19% on multi-year memory supply deals, CoreWeave about 22% and Dell about 20%; Zscaler climbed nearly 18% on a roughly $44 billion all-stock deal from CrowdStrike, which fell about 9%.

Strategists said much of the jump came from short covering and options hedging rather than a change in worries about inflation, rates or AI spending; oil fell and the S&P 500 won back just over half of last week's loss.
events: Thu 26 Nov: US markets closed for Thanksgiving; Fri 27 Nov closes early, at 21:00 Kuwait time.
Wed 9 Dec, 22:00 Kuwait time: Federal Reserve rate decision; markets price roughly a 90% chance of a hike.
